69014406.title: 69014406_Title
69014406.desc: · Successfully <color=#FFAF2C>inflicting Impaired</color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>1000 Performance Points</color>; successfully <color=#FFAF2C>countering <Term:2000003></Term></color> grants <color=#FFAF2C>500 Performance Points</color> each time; <color=#FFAF2C>preventing an enemy's Corruptive Barrier from completing its charge</color> and rendering them Impaired grants <color=#FFAF2C>1,500 Performance Points</color>.  During the <Term:2000003></Term>, when triggering <color=#FFAF2C>Shutdown</color> via <color=#FFAF2C><Term:2000006></Term></color>, obtain the remaining Performance Points available from the current <color=#FFAF2C>Control Skill</color>. Maximum obtainable Performance Points: 5,000.

69014804.title: TBD
69014804.desc:
· When an Agent inflicts an Attribute Anomaly status on an enemy, the target enemy gains 1 stack of the corresponding attribute's [Corrosion Mark]; when an enemy's Gash is removed due to Maim settlement, it gains 2 stacks of attribute-less [Corrosion Mark], lasting 10s. [Corrosion Mark] can stack up to 3 stacks max. Repeated triggers of the same attribute's [Corrosion Mark] refresh the duration.
· For each stack of [Corrosion Mark] an enemy holds, <color=#FFAF2C>Attribute Anomaly DMG taken is increased by 10%</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>DMG taken by <Term:2000001></Term> is increased by 15%</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>Sharp DMG taken is increased by 20%</color>.

· When an enemy becomes Stunned, it directly gains 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Residual Glow Mark</color>.
